Real protocol runs order is before / draft-after / before-return / final-after-exact, each with20s two stationary roles,30s two stationary plus6moving response-paced roles,20s all moving. Only old/new move implementation changes; three new owned copies have explicit pre-start2000ammo/100satiety/normal rifle-vest, no asset reset during measurement. No browser/native/render load.

Nominal main150ms timers are response-independent, not exact constant offered load; six bots are response-paced200ms and reduce load when replies slow. Actual per-role counts differ slightly. All observed errors/corrections/pending zero, all recorded moves accepted; explicit later audit asserts these conditions.

After skips exactly the stationary-count building queries: queries equal moving plus full snapshots; before variants equal all moves plus snapshots. Compare recorded counts and conditional method costs, not claimed whole-game speedup. Synchronous method wall durations include nested work, probe/GC/scheduling/SQL effects and must not be summed as exclusive CPU.

In mixed sample, same570 stationary packets cost857.3202ms before vs4.4392ms after. Query calls1584 to1014, total move2183.2117ms to1380.4501ms; moving subset1325.8915ms to1376.0109ms shows no moving-path improvement.

All-moving control964packets: initial before1293.3566ms, after1610.2997ms, return-before1603.4962ms. Returning old code also slowed, so the first one-way difference cannot be assigned solely to the change. This nonrandomized short ABA cannot prove no moving regression or full capacity; loop/RTT remain variable. Both initial asymmetric-call-shape draft and exact micro all-moving after are slower in4of5 rounds, retained rather than hidden. Reviewer found before assigned own-instance move while after used prototype, so balancedExactMicrobenchmark assigns both as own methods. Even balanced exact all-moving after is slower in4of5 rounds (about18.4%,5.9%,5.3%,-4.9%,7.4%); do not erase that risk signal. Different implementation modules, shared JIT/GC, fixed scenario order and short warming remain limitations.

Final all-moving962 accepted packets take1366.7238ms, P952.3972ms, loop max95.354879ms; within variable old-run range for cost, but this does not exclude a5–18% moving-path regression. Retain risk, accept only demonstrated idle-work elimination, not whole performance.
